name: Thomas
source: He is a Labrador Retriever with black fur kept by the house next door to Noa and her family.The woman who lives next door often asks Noa and her family to take Tomas for walks. The two are so close to each other that Noa often brushes his hair and feeds him in the morning and at night. Full of energy and a glutton for food. He is also mischievous, eating Nodachi's (Noa’s) Daifuku and getting chased by her.  He also seems not to be very shy, as evidenced by the fact that he immediately took to Kazuhiro. He also seems to be a rather intelligent dog, as he is skilled at negotiating and calming Nodachi's (Noa’s) anger and making her give up.
